runtime_integration: 308/308 creative assets provisionally integrated under game/assets. Player idle/walk and idle/move SpriteFrames for all nine common enemy roles, the elite prototype and both boss roles play from simulation time. Attack frames play during shooter/exploder fuses and boss telegraph/charge phases. Death animations now survive ECS despawn and play for their metadata-defined duration. Generated SFX families and menu/result/adaptive music remain connected. Human visual and auditory review remains pending.
artistic_review: Internal pixel-level review corrected a four-direction orientation defect in the player sheets. The static catalog remains geometric and non-player animation is still procedural role work; these are provisionally integrated prototypes, not a human-approved production art pass. A redesigned batch of 31 role-specific weapon/evolution/relic catalog icons passed palette, dimensions, color-count, source/export hash, and Godot smoke checks and replaced only those explicitly authorized managed IDs. Catalog readability and the provisional shapes/colors still need owner review. A technical audit found that the generated SpriteFrames resources stored atlas regions as unsupported frame fields, so Godot treated full sheets as every frame. All 131 animation resources now use per-frame AtlasTexture subresources and pass a manifest-driven Godot smoke; boss/elite animation sheets were regenerated at native 96x96/24x24 cel dimensions. Runtime now plays idle/move frames for all 12 enemy/elite/boss roles from simulation time, plus attack frames during shooter/exploder fuses and boss telegraph/charge phases. Special and projectile/weapon/pickup animation resources remain integrated but are not yet all connected to runtime events; death cadence follows authored provisional metadata. Human art review remains pending.
limitations: Candidates were generated locally by deterministic primitive/oscillator recipes; a passing technical validator does not establish production artistic quality.
Music tempo/key/arrangements and final gain balance remain proposed.
Headless audio cannot replace auditory review; local review page includes playback controls.
Human visual and auditory acceptance remains pending; current integration is provisional per the user-authorized non-canonical prototype scope.
Audio hardware is unavailable in this session, so numeric QA and Godot playback/import tests do not substitute for listening.
Some boss, biome, font and detailed animation conventions remain open in the GDD and stay explicitly provisional.

One earlier full CTest run had a transient Toxic Ignition assertion failure; six targeted reruns and subsequent complete runs (119/119, then 120/120) passed. Keep monitoring this gameplay test for intermittent behavior.
The survival_adaptive.wav and boss_intensity.wav full mixes are listening/reference renders; runtime music is composed from the synchronized stems. Their use is recorded in the asset manifest.

Enemy, elite and boss idle/move SpriteFrames now play in Survival and Sandbox. Attack frames play during shooter/exploder fuses and boss telegraph/charge phases; enemy/elite/boss death animations play from death events using authored provisional timing. Special and projectile/weapon/pickup animation resources remain to be wired to their gameplay events; timing and art review remain provisional.
